events.label: Funiculi Funicula café; ghost occupies the seat
events.description: In a basement Tokyo café, Funiculi Funicula, one particular chair lets a visitor travel through time - when the seat is free of the ghost who haunts it.

events.label: Rules: one seat; cannot leave; café visitors only; present immutable; coffee timer
events.description: The rules are strict: travel only to times the café has existed, only to meet people who have visited it, nothing can change the present, and you must return before your coffee goes cold.

events.label: Fumiko travels to confront boyfriend before US job
events.description: Fumiko travels back to confront the boyfriend who left for America without telling her he was going.

events.label: Fumiko returns; present unchanged; resolve reframed
events.description: She returns with nothing changed except herself: the past stays fixed, but she leaves the café ready to face her future differently.

events.label: Kohtake seeks letter from Alzheimer husband
events.description: Nurse Kohtake travels to read the letter her husband, losing himself to Alzheimer's, wrote her while he could still remember who she was.

events.label: Letter visit; present unchanged; care transformed
events.description: The present refuses to change - his illness remains - but she comes back able to love the man he still is, memory and all.

events.label: Hirai confronts estranged sister
events.description: Hirai, the café owner's sister, travels to speak to the younger sister who ran from the family business and from her.

events.label: Sister visit; present unchanged; reconciliation begins
events.description: Nothing in the past moves, but the visit cracks open the estrangement, and the two sisters begin again.

events.label: Kei travels to future to meet yet-unborn daughter
events.description: Barmaid Kei travels far forward to meet the daughter she will not live to raise, as an adult.

events.label: Future meeting strengthens Kei's will to live
events.description: Meeting the grown daughter - and reading her heart - gives Kei the strength to choose the life she was afraid to begin.

events.label: Overstay coffee → become ghost in the seat
events.description: The rule's edge: stay past the last sip and you become the café's ghost - the figure who waits forever in the seat.

events.label: Past unalterable in outcome; conversations change how one faces future
events.description: The café cannot change one second of the present - only the heart of the person who makes the trip, which turns out to be enough.

events.label: Cafe rules explained
events.description: The café's peculiar rules, laid out by its unsmiling staff.

events.label: Sit in ghost seat; travel
events.description: Sit in the ghost's chair and the journey begins.

events.label: Must return before coffee cools
events.description: The cup on the table is the clock: come back before it cools, or stay forever.

events.label: Woman seeks letter from lover
events.description: A visitor seeks a letter from a lover, long gone.

events.label: Nurse visits sister
events.description: The nurse crosses time to visit her sister.

events.label: Couple reconciliation visit
events.description: A couple arrives to say what they never said.

events.label: Mother-daughter visit
events.description: A mother takes the seat to meet her daughter.

events.label: Cannot change present; only feelings
events.description: The limit everyone learns: the present cannot be changed - only the person who travels.

events.label: Cafe continues receiving seekers
events.description: The café goes on, pouring coffee and receiving whoever needs the seat next.

ruleEffects.effect: Explicitly: whatever happens in the past, the present does not change
Emotional/knowledge change without causal overwrite of present facts

outcome.summary: Four rule-bound visits; present unchanged; characters transformed in how they face open futures.
